title: Shared frontmatter fields
description: Fields every document type shares (spec 3.2). Type schemas add id, category and their own fields, list what is required and reject unknown fields.

intent.description: AI-facing, at most 200 characters: why another agent should read this.

when.description: AI-facing: when the document is relevant.

relations.description: Relations to other documents, Jira or URLs.

featured.description: Inject the full body at session start.

type.description: Relation type. Forward types are written by authors; inverse types (superseded-by, amended-by, depended-on-by, implemented-by, used-by, attached-to) only by the bot. relates-to is its own inverse.

target.description: ADR-0001, PROC-0001, TECH-0001, REL-0001, ATT-0001, CODE:org/repo/path, JIRA:KEY-123 or an http(s) URL.

link.description: Resolved link: relative path to the target file, or the URL for JIRA and external targets.
